channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US House begins vote on motion to advance impeachment of Pete Hegseth
item.description: Hegseth has been accused of spearheading war on Iran without required congressional approval.

item.title: IBM’s biggest division ends most US foreign worker sponsorships
item.description: Announcement follows Trump administration crackdown on visa programmes for skilled foreign workers.

item.title: Iraq blocks Iranian football team’s plane from landing over US sanctions
item.description: Iraq has barred Iran’s national football team from landing in Basra due to US sanctions on Iranian airlines.

item.title: US voters want Democrats focused on ending Iran war, lowering costs: Poll
item.description: Poll shows majority of Americans want Congress to prioritise addressing rising cost of living and economic challenges.

item.title: Rubio says no need for major combat operations against Iran
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says there is “no need” for further major combat operations against Iran

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: 14-year-old killed in West Bank raid
item.description: Israeli forces kill a 14-year-old Palestinian boy in Burqa, as settlers assault a woman near Hebron.

item.title: Spain braces for nationwide strike as anger over housing, costs boils over
item.description: The 24-hour walkout, called by Spain’s two biggest unions, is due to start on Wednesday.

item.title: US petrol prices are down, but elevated inflation continues
item.description: Inflation has remained high, despite some easing in fuel prices caused by the US war on Iran.

item.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

item.title: Board of Peace says Israel's aid response after Gaza floods 'insufficent'
item.description: The group, formed by Trump, issues rare criticism of Israel, while also blaming Hamas for the suffering of civilians in Gaza.
